_about: Samsung Galaxy Buds message table: the messages PairFree reads or sends, and the ones it never sends. A message is one byte, written in decimal as GalaxyBudsClient numbers them. to: earbuds (PairFree sends it), phone (the earbuds send it), both. Payloads are as GalaxyBudsClient's encoders and decoders give them; see docs/samsung/PROTOCOL.md. never_send marks messages PairFree never sends.

source.author: Tim Schneeberger
source.note: Names follow GalaxyBudsClient (Message/SppMessageEnums.cs), which took them from Samsung's own apps.

frame.crc: CRC-16/XMODEM (polynomial 1021, start 0) over the message id and the payload, sent low byte first.
frame.standard: som, length (2 bytes, little-endian: bits 0-9 the length of id, payload and CRC; 0x1000 and 0x2000 are flags), id, payload, CRC, eom.
frame.legacy: som, type (0 request, 1 response), length (1 byte: id, payload and CRC), id, payload, CRC, eom. The Galaxy Buds (2019) only.

messages.note: Extra clear call sound. Payload: 1 on, 0 off.
Acknowledges a setting: the message id, then the value as set (for the seamless connection and call path messages, inverted as sent).
Factory reset.
A result: the message id, a result code, sometimes one more byte.
Sent unasked: batteries, whether both earbuds are linked, where each is; the layout depends on the model (docs/samsung/PROTOCOL.md section 5).
Sent unasked on connecting and after changes: every setting, laid out by model and revision (docs/samsung/PROTOCOL.md section 5).
No payload to ask; the reply holds each earbud's hardware and software version. The Buds3 and later do not answer.
No payload to ask; the reply holds the preset count, the band count, every preset's bands but the flat one, then the custom bands.
Switch calls to the earbuds when they go in. Payload: 0 on, 1 off.
Noise controls with one earbud in. Payload: 1 on, 0 off.
The noise control mode after a change by touch: 0 off, 1 noise cancelling, 2 ambient sound, 3 adaptive; sometimes the wearing state after it.
Payload: the noise control mode, as in 119.

Which modes touch and hold switches between, per side (docs/samsung/PROTOCOL.md section 7). On the Buds4 family (Samsung's plugin): left, then right, each 1 ambient + 2 adaptive + 4 off + 8 noise cancelling.
Voice detect. Payload: 1 on, 0 off.
How long voice detect waits after you stop talking. Payload: 0 for 5 s, 1 for 10 s, 2 for 15 s.
Ambient sound on the Galaxy Buds and Buds+. Payload: 1 on, 0 off.
Ambient sound after a change by touch: 1 on, 0 off.
Payload: on, left volume, right volume, tone. On the Buds4 family (Samsung's plugin): on, left, right, conversation boost, noise reduction amplify, its level.
Noise cancelling level on models with two. Payload: 1 high, 0 low.
Ambient sound volume step, 0 to the model's highest.
Voice focus on the Galaxy Buds (2019). Payload: 1 on, 0 off. Later models use 133 for another setting.
Payload: 0 off, or the preset + 1 (presets: 0 bass boost, 1 soft, 2 dynamic, 3 clear, 4 treble boost; 6 the custom curve). The Galaxy Buds (2019): on, then the preset + 5.
Sent after the first extended status. Payload: 1, the phone (1 Samsung, 2 other), its Android SDK version.
The custom EQ curve, on models with it: the band count (9), then each band's gain from -10 to 10. It takes effect with equalizer preset 6.
Ambient sound during calls. Payload: 1 on, 0 off.
Left-right balance, 0 to 32; 16 is the middle.

Older models: 1 locks touch, 0 unlocks. Models with per-gesture locks: touch on, single tap, double tap, triple tap, touch and hold, then on some double tap and hold during calls; each 1 on, 0 off. On the Buds4 family (Samsung's plugin): touch on, single, double, triple, hold, double for calls, hold for calls, swipe, 1, 1.
1 when touch is locked.

What touch and hold does: the left earbud's option byte, then the right's (data/samsung/devices.json touch_hold). On the Buds4 family (Samsung's plugin) two more bytes follow: each side's assistant, 1 Google, 2 another, 0 when the option is not the digital assistant.
Double tap the earbud's edge for volume. Payload: 1 on, 0 off.
Extra loud ambient sound: one more volume step. Payload: 1 on, 0 off.
Wake up the voice assistant by voice. Payload: 1 on, 0 off.
Noise cancelling on the Galaxy Buds Live. Payload: 1 on, 0 off.
Noise cancelling on the Galaxy Buds Live after a change by touch: 1 on, 0 off.
Fit test. Payload: 1 starts, 0 stops.
Fit test result, left then right: 0 poor, 1 good, 2 the test failed.
Relieve pressure with ambient sound, on the Galaxy Buds Live. Payload: 1 on, 0 off.
The earbuds start to beep. No payload.
No payload.
While finding: mute left, mute right; each 1 muted, 0 not.
Left muted, right muted.
Start beeping, also while the earbuds are worn, on models with that. No payload.
Seamless earbud connection. Payload: 0 on, 1 off; on the Buds4 family 1 on, 0 off (Samsung's plugin).
Asks for the serial numbers. PairFree never needs them.

No payload to ask; the reply holds each earbud's hardware version (1 byte each), then each earbud's software version as 20 bytes of text, left first, then 2 bytes. The Buds4 family answers it (Samsung's plugin).
Pause media when one earbud is taken out. Payload: 1 on, 0 off (Samsung's plugin).
Adaptive volume. Payload: 1 on, 0 off (Samsung's plugin).
Siren detection. Payload: 1 on, 0 off (Samsung's plugin).
Runs the earbuds' self diagnostics.
Buds4 Pro: the adaptive response level, loud noise reduction (1 on), then 0 (Samsung's plugin).
Buds4 family: voice boost, then volume normalisation, 1 on each (Samsung's plugin).
H1: the minutes before it turns itself off, 30, 60 or 120 (Samsung's plugin).
360 audio, then head tracking, 1 on each (Samsung's plugin; GalaxyBudsClient's SpatialSensorManager).
Buds4 family: the neck stretch reminder, 1 on (Samsung's plugin).
Buds4 family: adjust sound to fit, 1 on (Samsung's plugin).
